purpose: Test whether the already frozen a-priori PATH_GEOMETRIC_D penetration scale can improve actual standard-LARE state propagation by placing a fixed four-state grid around the predicted hydraulically active depth.

trigger_authority.interpretation: MECH3 provides the prospective pre-simulation depth scale; MECH4 supplies mechanistic support that local capillary-potential curvature ranks interface-gradient risk. Fine-trajectory curvature itself is forbidden as a grid-selection oracle.

external_material_authority.source: Carsel and Parrish (1988) textural class Mualem-van Genuchten parameters as reproduced in HYDRUS
external_material_authority.selection_rule: Three textural classes not used in MECH3B or MECH4B blind panels, spanning coarse-to-fine hydraulic behavior.

experiment.standard_lare: unchanged CA1 adjacent fixed-layer closure with iterative Heun numerical-floor route; no closure repair

prediction_rule.constitutive_target: For forcing multiplier r, solve K(theta_f)=r*K(theta0) within the unsaturated constitutive domain.
prediction_rule.snapping: nearest ladder member; ties choose smaller L
prediction_rule.censoring: If continuous L_pred lies outside [20,140] cm, mark GRID_PREDICTION_OUTSIDE_DESIGN_DOMAIN and do not clamp into the candidate comparison.

PATH_R4.definition: For uncensored snapped L*, boundaries [0,L*-10,L*,L*+10,160] cm.

BOTTOM_R4.role: equal-dimension fixed bottom-refined control inherited from B01 groundwater laboratory

common_observation_operator.method: Integrate candidate piecewise-constant layer theta over each fixed 20-cm diagnostic band; observation only, never fed back into dynamics.
common_observation_operator.rationale: Different candidate grids cannot be compared fairly by their own native layer-storage errors.

numerical_authority.integrator: iterative Heun predictor-corrector as in DYN0A
numerical_authority.domain: theta_r < theta_bar_i < theta_s and standard MvG branch psi>0.01 cm

reference_domain_policy.minimum_panel: At least 10 uncensored qualified cases overall; every material must contribute at least one WET and one DRY case. Otherwise close GRID1_REFERENCE_PANEL_INSUFFICIENT.

per_case: max absolute 20-cm-band storage error over time
maximum absolute fine-vs-reduced total storage difference as structural check

adjudication.PATH_GUIDED_GRID_PROPAGATION_SUPPORTED: Panel sufficient AND PATH_R4 is no worse than U4, BOTTOM_R4 and TOP_R4 on all three pooled primary storage-error components and qualified coverage, with strict improvement over every fixed control on at least one component.
adjudication.PATH_GUIDED_GRID_PROPAGATION_PARTIAL: Panel sufficient AND PATH_R4 Pareto-dominates at least one fixed control but not all three.
adjudication.PATH_GUIDED_GRID_PROPAGATION_NOT_SUPPORT: Panel sufficient AND PATH_R4 Pareto-dominates none of the fixed controls.
